mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods where FEDFUNDS declines relative to 12-month average shows no statistically significant positive mean compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In all instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, the 5-day forward return is positive 50% or more of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate contraction in the broader demand environment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive central bank intervention to curb inflation, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), the 20-day forward return is negative 60% or more of the time when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods of rising RSAFS shows no significant positive mean compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month low, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO is below its 12-month low.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market stress that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, the 20-day forward return is positive 60% or more of the time.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annualized and HOUST declines, the 60-day forward return is positive 60% or more of the time.
